# Front Sway Bar Center Disconnect

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Cut a section out of the front sway bar and weld splined axle segments into the cutout to create an internal shaft. [t276]

Cut the front sway bar between its two bushing mounts, then install a central dowel and rubber washer. [t276]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Cut a section out of the front sway bar.
2. Weld splined axle segments into the cutout to create an internal shaft.

_Procedure reported by [t276]._

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t276] [Partial]</summary>

1. Cut the front sway bar between its two bushing mounts to create a disconnected section.
2. [Partial] Install a central dowel and rubber washer between the two stub sections of the cut bar.

</details>

## Tools

- Welder [t276]
- Saw or cutting tool [t276]

## Parts

- 1 GM Side Gear for 7.5" rear end: Must be a 26 spline to mate with axle shafts [t276]
- 2 GM Rear Axle Shafts for 7.5" rear end: Must have 26 splines and ~1.125" OD on the splines [t276]
- [Partial] Front Sway Bar, Xterra: To be cut open [t276]

## Specifications

- **Axle Shaft Spline Count (GM)**: 26 splines [t276] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Axle Shaft Spline OD (GM)**: ~1.125" [t276] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Side Gear Spline Count (GM)**: 26 splines [t276] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Use clamping collars to connect and disconnect the sections. [t276]
